title: Kiln ROCm/HF Layer Attribution Result v2
description: Source-bound sequential comparison of Hugging Face and Kiln ROCm hidden states after embedding, each of 32 Qwen3.5 transformer layers, and final RMSNorm at one exact first-divergence state. It locates where numerical error grows; it does not establish general model parity.
